paragraphs.text: Chinese-recipe browser RPA (webclaw-lite) + DeepSeek Harness dsh-plugin
﻿# webclaw-oss
**Deterministic browser RPA driven by natural-language recipes (Chinese first).**
This repository is the open-source fork of webclaw for the DeepSeek Harness community (`dsh-plugin`
pository is the open-source fork of webclaw for the DeepSeek Harness community (`dsh-plugin` topic).
## Core
| Piece | Role |
| `runtime/` | Rust **webclaw-lite** CLI — parse Chinese recipes, drive local Chrome via CDP, HITL f

or captcha/slider |
| `packages/webclaw/` | npm **`@lonk1989/webclaw`** — Host tools + Skill that sp

/slider |
| `packages/webclaw/` | npm **`@lonk1989/webclaw`** — Host tools + Skill that spawn lite |
Same recipe → same business path. Prefer fixing the recipe over inventing CSS selectors.
## Non-goals (v1)

- Not a Playwright / Stagehand / element-tool MCP
- Does not register exclusive `ctx.browserUse`
- N

o enterprise corp-session skill cloud
- Desktop Tauri UI is not part of the OSS v1 publish surface
-
English recipe keywords are planned later
## Quick start
### 1. Install the DSH plugin (recommended)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
On **Windows** and **macOS (Apple Silicon)**, the plugin **auto-downloads** `webclaw-lite` from GitH
ub Releases on first boot / tool call (SHA256 verified → `%LOCALAPPDATA%\webclaw\bin\webclaw-lite.ex
e` or `~/.webclaw/bin/webclaw-lite`). No separate hand install. If macOS Gatekeeper blocks the binar
y: `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine ~/.webclaw/bin/webclaw-lite`.

Ask the agent to run a recipe such as:

When you paste a **full** multi-step recipe, the agent should call **one** `webclaw_run` with the en
tire body (not probe step-by-step).
**Accounts / SSO:** put the real login URL in DSH **设置 → 网站账号** (Feishu SSO e.g. `…/login?sso=lark&…
` — password optional). Never put passwords in chat. Recipes say `登录EHR系统`, never `输入密码=…`. Prefab `
参数…=` are placeholders—confirm or「用默认」; if the user already gave fields, just run. Private forks see
d URLs via `config.systems` (see `packages/webclaw/README.md`).
